title: Fix: Task template should not appear in TecFactory task board
description: The file tasks/0_task_template.json is loaded and displayed as a regular task in the TecFactory task board. The loadAllTasks() function in tecfactory/server.js reads all .json files from the tasks/ folder without excluding the template file. Fix: filter out 0_task_template.json (or files matching a template naming pattern) when loading tasks in the server's loadAllTasks() function.
